import cv2,numpy as np
c=cv2.VideoCapture('example_video.mp4')
fs=[]
while True:
  r,f=c.read()
  if not r:break
  fs.append(f)
A=np.array(fs)
bg=np.median(A,axis=0).astype(np.uint8)
for i in range(40,80):
  d=cv2.absdiff(fs[i],bg).max(axis=2)
  m=(d>40).astype(np.uint8)
  m=cv2.morphologyEx(m,cv2.MORPH_OPEN,np.ones((3,3),np.uint8))
  m=cv2.morphologyEx(m,cv2.MORPH_CLOSE,np.ones((15,15),np.uint8))
  n,l,st,ce=cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(m)
  if n>1:
    k=1+np.argmax(st[1:,4]); x,y,w,h,a=st[k]
    print(i,x,y,w,h,a,'bottom',y+h)
"
